ValidationRule.description: Date TCM Setup Completed must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: RecordType_Name__c = "NCSP: New Customer Setup" && OR( ( NOT(ISCHANGED(Open_Tasks__c)) && ISCHANGED(Date_TCM_Setup_Completed__c ) && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_TCM_Setup_Completed__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_TCM_Setup_Completed__c ) != TODAY() && ( ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Date_TCM_Setup_Completed__c )) || DATEVALUE(Date_TCM_Setup_Completed__c ) != DATEVALUE(PRIORVALUE(Date_TCM_Setup_Completed__c )) ) ), ( ISNEW() && NOT(ISBLANK(Date_TCM_Setup_Completed__c )) && DATEVALUE(Date_TCM_Setup_Completed__c ) != TODAY() ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date TCM Setup Completed must be today's date. It cannot be in the Past or the Future.
